'''Yinchorr''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and was [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was first charted c. [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
===Early history===
Yinchorr was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the reptilian [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] which gradually organized themselves into rival city-states. According to ancient epochs, [[Tol-Kachorn]] was the strongest of these, with almost one hundred small communities providing it with resources and five lesser city-states serving as service centers. Several other polities tried to challenge the supremacy of Tol-Kachorn, confrontations that sparked wars of conquest that always ended in the defeat of the contender—and the reign of chaos.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

===Galactic Republic===
Circa [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]], Yinchorr was charted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Alien [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] decided that the Yinchorri were too underdeveloped to be useful to the Republic, and the planet was deemed too deficient in resources to be useful for a settlement. On the scouts' advisement, the Republic disregarded the world.<ref name="UAA" /> Around [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]], the Yinchorri joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but most planetary representatives assumed that the species would go unnoticed in the grand scheme of [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide politics.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|107|YIN 1-2|Yinchorri Starfighter}}</ref> In the year [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Yinchorr also gained representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="UAA" />

The same year, under the manipulation of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], they launched an [[Yinchorri Uprising|uprising]] against the Galactic Republic, attacking neighbouring systems as well as the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] attempted to negotiate, but met only hostility. However, the uprising was put down, and the homeworld of the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] was placed under interdiction by the Republic.<ref name="JC">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref><ref name="DV">''[[Star Wars: The Devaronian Version]]''</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|This unforgiving planet has a fittingly severe training facility.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="ImpHandbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:The_squall.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[The Squall/Legends|The Squall]].]]
Later, in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] held the Yinchorri [[Council of Elders (Yinchorri)|Council of Elders]] hostage: in exchange for the Council's release, the Yinchorri attempted to deliver [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] captive to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="M86">[[Star Wars (1977) 86|''Star Wars'' (1977) 86]]</ref> In the end, the Empire slaughtered the Council, and the Yinchorri rebelled. As a result, the Empire devastated the world, destroying its main city, Tol-Kashorn.<ref name="AA" /> Most of the population was exterminated.<ref name="Atlas" /> It was during this battle that a young soldier, [[Redd Wessel]], first came to the attention of his superiors.

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] later had the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] set up on the now distant and devastated world. The harsh desert world made it ideal for the training of these elite guards.

===New Republic===
After the planet was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Yinchorri begin to rebuild their society, but did not rejoin the [[galactic community]].<ref name="AA" />

Yinchorr was used as a training ground for the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]]. Yinchorr was the home of the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]] and its dangerous arena known as [[The Squall/Legends|the Squall]]. [[Kir Kanos]] and [[Carnor Jax]] both trained on Yinchorr, and continually had flashbacks to their training.<ref name="ce 1">[[Crimson Empire 1|''Crimson Empire'' 1]]</ref>

===New Empire===
{{Quote|An Imperial base these past seven years and HQ for the 407th Stormtrooper Division|[[Anson Trask]]|<ref name="L4" />}}
After the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the planet became a military base for [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], serving as the HQ for the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="L4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref>

[[File:Yinchorr_legacy.jpg|250px|thumb|Yinchorr after the [[Sith–Imperial War]].]]

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' names [[Uhanayih]], [[Yitheeth]], and [[Yibikkoror]] as moons of Yinchorr, while [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'']] makes it clear they are separate planets.

In [[Star Wars (1977) 86|''Star Wars'' 86]], the planet was originally spelled "Yinchor".

''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places Yinchorr in the Expansion Region; however, ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' says that the planet is located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], whereas ''[[A Two-Edged Sword]]'' and the map in [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]] put it in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
